title: WebProfileViewer
description: A mod used to check hypixel player's bedwars stats in game!
body:
This mod has 2 new commands: /web and /weball to help you check player's hypixel bedwars data.  
1./web  
Usage:
```text
/web <playerName>
```
Output:
```text
<playerName>:  
Final K/D:...  
Doubles Final K/D:...  
4v4v4v4 Final K/D:...  
Total Wins:...  
```
![The output of the /web command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f251f2fb2a6a1483d71f6a7a0a33ee4279397627.png)
2./weball  
Usage: 
```text
/weball 
```
Output:
```text
playerName1 [1/Total online players]:  
Final K/D:...  
Doubles Final K/D:...  
4v4v4v4 Final K/D:...  
Total Wins:...  
playerName2 [2/Total online players]:  
...  
...  
...  
playerName... [Total online players/Total online players]:
...
Finished fetching stats for all online players.
Dangerous Players:
...
```
![The output of the /weball command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5ab3af57b359ca2fe5bd70a5f3a3acd032627da_0.webp)
3.Configure which stats to show in /web or /weball  
Press F8 to open mod screen:  
![mod screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92f2e5d58e01c9aa429cf440809282d589f3a596_0.webp)
Then press "Open config" button:  
![config menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63c1f52af4ec70770b4584dd716f610bad5b6858_0.webp)
Then choose "General Settings":  
![general settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f9c255fc6f2289ddd1a00864d87928f07c19bb8_0.webp)
And here you can choose all stats you wanna query, and also whether you want to enable AntiAFK feature (This will be introduced later).  
4.Show dangerous players  
A dangerous player list is displayed after using /weball command, like this:  
![How dangerous player list works](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d1172db35c46979f935773c592cc1cc5dadeb14_0.webp)
Players with a high FKDR or nicked players are considered dangerous.  
5.Change dangerous player's final K/D threshold  
If you don't think a player with 1 FKDR is dangerous, you can change the threshold FKDR by yourself! Simply use the command /weball config Dangerous_Players_Final_KD [set/get/reset] <Threshold FKDR> and only players with FKDR higher than threshold value will be considered dangerous. The default value is 1.
![Threshold value change](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa6761a7de331637dbef4d441b0288c965d81175_0.webp)![Threshold value set successfully](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/521f5c95f452f89e447f5a480d25f320bb526330_0.webp)
6.AntiAFK feature  
Press F9 key to enable AntiAFK feature, the mod will take control of your game input unless you press F9 again. The mod will automatically press a key after a random interval to simulate player input to stop AFK check countdown, the move direction is random, but don't worry- you won't walk iinto the void if you are not unlucky enough! Don't be bothered you will get kicked because the wall in move direction stops the move- this mod can handle this! The feature runs perfectly in hypixel bedwars! When this feature is enabled, an indicator is shown on screen. Here is how it looks like:
![AntiAFK indicator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/641de3df808c7cd78ee032ec37fc2cc3c80c7f8d_0.webp)
